title: Dusk til Dawn
note: P01-06 shows a body reaching across a projected outline. The finished portrait and photograph keep the ear, jaw and sideward glance.

title: Blackout photographs
note: The kneeling figure and bouquet can be matched between the isolated cutout and the room photograph. The empty hall on P02-13 supplies a counterweight to the mirrored hat.

title: The Blackout Awaits
note: The physical BLACK OUT flyer above a doorway around 15 seconds reappears in a cluster of flyers around 59 seconds. It creates continuity across spaces.

title: Streets of New York
note: The lifted arm and bent leg appear in a source rectangle and again as an enlarged figure. P04-05 moves two faces to opposite corners of a pink field.

title: Fly
note: Four red hoods descend across the waterfront in P05-01. Their isolated positions in P05-02 become the progressively larger blocks in P05-03.

title: DC Chronicles
note: Small figures sit beside tinted photos on dark red. Four versions of the gallery bench in P06-08 flip the orientation of the room.

title: Proud Daddy
note: The ball, hands and armchair align between reference and painting. P07-02 establishes physical scale. P07-10 places a number 30 jersey beside the canvas.

title: To Bleed in Liquid Gold
note: The camera travels around the heart and support in P08-02. P08-03 reveals the weight of the bead pile. P08-07 looks down on a hand over the same materials.
folder: P08 - To Bleed in Liquid Gold

title: Graphic pose studies
note: The profile with glasses repeats in flat yellow behind the photographic figure. P09-13 places one aisle image in a much larger yellow field.

title: Record-store portraits
note: Both hands on the red cap survive tinting and repetition. A close photographic match appears across posts in P11-04.

title: Record-store shoot
note: Hands on the cap in P11-04 and records in front of a face in P11-01 furnish landmarks for the finished layouts in P10-01 and P10-05.

title: First Weeks at RISD
note: A three-panel branch study sits on white. The light table, blue tape and outdoor drawing board give a view of how the work is made.

title: Artful and Grateful
note: A portrait against clouds gathers smaller photographs on a white ground. P13-06 keeps a single sharp flame over its soft reflection.

title: Italy in motion
note: P14-16 brackets a balancing gallery pose with smaller views. P14-05 gives the transit photograph a broad white surround.

title: Domus Dei
note: P15-02 places shoe views over patterned floors. P15-07 aligns a round gold medallion above a pointed arch. The white mat on P15-03 isolates one interior.
